authoring_rationale: Class A: attribution and provenance. The two notes are identical except that the drafting and checking roles are swapped: in one the group steward drafted and the editorial group checked; in the other the editorial group drafted and the group steward checked. The declared origin of the guide and the attribution of its authorship and of its review differ, so the attribution and provenance record differs downstream. Locatable at the first sentence of each variant. Same in both: checked before entering the library, suggestions go to the editorial group, which keeps it current. No surface feature varied; exercises textual similarity not being governance equivalence. Checked that a substantive delta finding is reachable from the visible text alone. Authored fresh from the public ADR-0054 and ADR-0055 law only; not adapted from or templated on any other case or corpus; no void-attempt material used. Orientation and identity computed mechanically from the final bytes (ADR-0055 decisions 7, 8 and 11); no wording was adjusted for orientation, identity or position.
